evidence_quotes: Eidsvoll Taktekking AS blir en del av Teqt Group
Teqt Group styrker sin posisjon i Norge med oppkjøpet av Eidsvoll Taktekking AS
data.reason: The article reports on the acquisition of Eidsvoll Taktekking AS by the parent entity Teqt Group. While the target company TEQT NORGE AS is part of the group, the news is about the group's expansion and the acquisition of a third-party entity, not a specific development of the target legal entity itself.
